description: Double-check and extend historical IHACPA coverage back to 2012-13 where official pricing specifications exist, while distinguishing older NHCDC cost evidence from NWAU calculator support.

support_scope.summary: Covers 2012-13 through 2026-27 historical provenance for NEP determinations, pricing specifications, calculator availability, price weights, and NHCDC costing evidence. NHCDC is cost evidence only, and 2012-13 calculator support remains an explicit gap.

gap_register.summary: No direct 2012-13 NWAU calculator artifact is proven; support must not be inferred from pricing specifications or NHCDC evidence.
Foundational PDF hashes are recorded, but a full hash census across every historical artifact remains outside this provenance-audit closure.
